description: Modoc County, CA – Today, Heather Hadwick, Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 1, announces an endorsement from Shannon Struble, President of the Butte Valley Unified School Board. Struble’s endorsement underscores the growing support of Hadwick’s campaign and her commitment to ensuring students of the North State receive an education that prepares them for life. “I am thankful to receive an endorsement from Butte Valley School Board President Shannon Struble,” said Heath
